sources.source: Exactly frozen F124-AG generator/causal admission via function-global cohort rebinding; after original pair admitted, apply public relation transformation to ALL edge source bits and public role strings symmetrically for both labels.

new_public_causal_rules.xor16: candidate edge src bits equal bitwise-NOT of previous dst bits
new_public_causal_rules.rotate4: candidate edge src bits equal previous dst bits rotated 4 to the left

sources.role_encoding: Every public query role and every edge role prefixed rel_xor16: or rel_rotate4:; both labels share public rule and graph/query census
sources.oracle: Evaluator-only inverse of public src-bit transform and public role prefix then unchanged original 7-15 hop causal admission. Models never call oracle.
sources.oracle_limits: Positive exactly one, negative zero. Original raw exact-key path must be absent in both transformed graphs. Same public edge topology, token multiset, target and roles across pairs.

Yggdrasil.test: FROZEN F124-AG selected eta=.1 source-blind inference with 7 active + 9 retained, original weights and source/target role semantics unchanged. Do not train or adapt to rule tokens.

Wingless.test: FROZEN F124-AG original 1 state/node packed 12-bit source-blind inference and separate diagnostic observer; no adjustment to model or extra stored per-node state.
Wingless.diagnostic: Replay exact original Wingless one-state candidate/kept packed states per hop before any oracle; after forward, separately derive transformed-rule public true path and find first lost raw-key proxy/candidate, distinguish compressed false retention, record hopwise FP/FN and raw-key checksum alias risks.
